stagingMacroBlocks.body: Create a live-action micro-scene set on a warm golden-hour New York City sidewalk, alternating between paw-height third-person tracking and subjective feline POV as Miso, a ginger tabby cat, stalks a dried street leaf past towering pedestrians before darting beneath a parked yellow cab.

Maintain a continuous left-to-right sidewalk path in third-person tracking (CAM 01), preserving Miso's sleek ginger tabby coat, four white paws, and collarless neck across every cut. In subjective POV (CAM 02), the camera serves strictly as Miso's eyes at paw height using only world parallax and lower-edge whisker framing before cutting back to third-person (CAM 01) and the under-cab refuge (CAM 03).

stagingMacroBlocks.body: Low-angle tracking medium shot at paw height on a sunlit New York concrete sidewalk, with weathered brownstone stoops and long golden-hour shadows stretching across the pavement. Frame-left midground, Miso, a sleek ginger tabby cat with white paws, stands facing screen-right, front left paw lifted mid-stride above the warm concrete while her other three paws rest on the gritty surface. Frame-right foreground, a dry curled maple leaf rests near the curb edge beside the dark lower cuffs and leather heels of sidewalk pedestrians. Miso holds a low, alert stance with her ears angled forward and her amber eyes fixed screen-right on the leaf.
